findings.current_behavior: refreshMapOverridesInPlace mutates the already-loaded MapData; applyMapOverrides applies only rows returned by /maps/:id/overrides and returns when the list is empty.
findings.failure: When a published override is deleted, absent rows do not restore the static tile/layer baseline; connected players can retain removed terrain or blocking until a full map reload.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Un jugador dentro del mapa ve los cambios sin reconectarse
findings.donor_closure: PR #3 rebuilds a detached static baseline, applies current overrides to it, generation-fences overlapping refreshes, then copies graphics/blocked back into retained tile identities.

findings.current_behavior: baseTileSnapshots is keyed by x,y,layer but stores tile.blocked, while game_map_tile_overrides permits multiple layer rows for the same x,y.
findings.failure: A later layer can snapshot an earlier layer's applied blocked value as if it were the baseline. Removing all layer overrides can restore that intermediate value and leave a base-walkable tile blocked.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Un jugador que queda sobre un tile ahora bloqueado no queda atrapado / publication applies the actual latest map
findings.donor_closure: PR #3 stores blocking once per x,y and graphics per layer, restores the original tile values before applying the next complete publication, and derives block deltas from actual before/after terrain.

findings.current_behavior: incomingUiPackets invokes refreshMapOverridesInPlace but does not request a scene redraw after mutating engine.mapData.
findings.failure: The retained Pixi scene can continue displaying old tile sprites even when MapData changed.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Un jugador dentro del mapa ve los cambios sin reconectarse
findings.donor_closure: PR #3 returns changed coordinates and calls ctx.redrawMapTiles after a successful refresh.
